THE_FINDING_THAT_GOVERNS_THIS_PACKET.statement: The two R65 measurements are not two isolated nulls. They are the fourth and fifth measured nulls in the exchange-open-interest neighbourhood, and together with the burden now standing at 8,415 they establish that a CADENCE-21 CROSS-SECTIONAL FUTURES BOOK CAN NO LONGER CLEAR ITS OWN DETECTION FLOOR IN THIS ESTATE, whatever its signal.
THE_FINDING_THAT_GOVERNS_THIS_PACKET.the_arithmetic_frozen_before_any_new_mea: CROSS_ASSET_FUTURES MDE_80 is 2.98%/yr net at burden 1 but 5.32%/yr at burden 100 and 5.96%/yr at burden 1000 (DIRECTOR_AGENDA.json lines 124-137). CROSS_ASSET already carries 2,448 charged rows, so the operative floor is the 5.3-6.0%/yr column, not 2.98%. The coordinator has now MEASURED what a rank-weighted, group-demeaned, monthly-rebalanced futures book of exactly this shape costs: 1.52%/yr and 2.11%/yr at turnover ~0.60. A cell of this shape must therefore deliver roughly 7-8.5%/yr GROSS to clear its floor NET. The measured gross effects of its two nearest siblings were +0.15%/yr and -2.47%/yr. No non-equity mechanism in 8,415 tests has produced a gross effect within an order of magnitude of 7%/yr.
THE_FINDING_THAT_GOVERNS_THIS_PACKET.consequence: The binding constraint on this estate is no longer idea supply. It is that burden has risen to where the cadence-21 cross-sectional panel cannot resolve any realistic effect. The only levers that change this are MORE DECISIONS (shorter horizon) and MORE BREADTH (the 68-market panel) - which is exactly what the coordinator is already building. More ideas at cadence 21 do not change it. This packet is therefore short by design and registers nothing today.
THE_FINDING_THAT_GOVERNS_THIS_PACKET.r65_03_is_not_merely_a_null: Gross -2.47%/yr, t=-2.59, hit rate 35.4%, BOTH halves negative. That is not an underpowered absence of evidence; it is a consistently wrong-signed signal. The fs_r65_03 frozen text already pre-committed the consequence: 'If it fails, director's recommendation for next campaign is to CLOSE POSITIONING|EXCHANGE_OPEN_INTEREST across futures with reopen condition NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION.' It failed. This director now makes that recommendation formally.

DO NOT PASS dataset_id, universe_id, pit_status OR frozen_gate_schema_hash. The pipeline DERIVES all four - dataset_id and universe_id from the published feature set, pit_status from the data certification, the gate hash from the contract. Passing them is at best ignored and at worst misleading.

The 68-market panel spans TWO stores (frozen r38_aggregate_oi_v1 for 39 commodity markets + new r65_aggregate_oi_cross_asset_v1 for 29). The feature set can name only one. THEREFORE: certify a single merged dataset id - proposed r65_cross_asset_curve_panel_v1 - that declares both components and carries the per-market dataset+vintage provenance. payload.hypothesis: Across the 68 markets of the certified futures book, the FRACTION OF LISTED DELIVERY MONTHS THAT CARRY POSITIVE EXCHANGE OPEN INTEREST - n_contracts_oi_positive divided by n_contracts_summed, averaged over the 21 sessions ending at t-2, demeaned against the market's own trailing 252-session norm and then within r59 economic group - predicts the cross-section of 68-market futures returns over the next 21 sessions, net of modelled per-market and roll cost. Measured on a merged panel: the frozen R56 dataset r38_aggregate_oi_v1 for 39 commodity markets and the R65 build r65_aggregate_oi_cross_asset_v1 for the 29 markets it never covered, both produced by the SAME imported data_r38.aggregate_market, with per-market dataset and vintage provenance carried on every row. This universe is the vendor's CURRENT-composition market list and is NOT survivorship-free. Per-market cost is MODELLED, not observed. This reopens the exchange-open-interest neighbourhood - four settled nulls and two pre-measurement rejects - on NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION: a COUNT of participating delivery months, a dimensionless bounded statistic computed from the whole-curve OI matrix, never read by any of 8,472 prior hypotheses. Every settled neighbour reads HOW MUCH open interest there is - the level, its growth, or its share of the curve. None reads HOW MANY MONTHS PARTICIPATE.
payload.mechanism: Term risk-bearing capacity. The number of delivery months a market is willing to carry open interest in measures how far along the curve participants will warehouse risk. When that participation contracts, capacity has been withdrawn from the term structure and the front contract must pay a larger premium to attract the marginal holder. The claim is about the BREADTH of the curve's participation, not about the size or direction of anyone's position, which is why it is a BREADTH family cell and not a POSITIONING one.

discovery_sample.start: DERIVED_AT_REGISTRATION: the first session on which at least 40 of the 68 markets are scorable on the merged panel, read mechanically off the built panel manifest. This is a read, not a choice; the concrete date must be written into the payload before the call and never adjusted afterwards.

payload.sample_split_rationale: The validation and lockbox boundaries are IDENTICAL to the two already-settled R65 cells, so this cell is directly comparable to them and the lockbox is the same untouched period. Only the discovery start differs, because the merged panel reaches back further than the intl-index panel did, and it is derived by a frozen coverage rule rather than chosen.

cost_model.effective_rate_rule: notional-weighted via alpha_agent.r61.cost_budget.effective_cost_per_side. Never a uniform rate, never a default.
cost_model.roll_cost_rule: Charged explicitly as additional_ann_cost_drag; may not be left at 0.0.
cost_model.measured_sibling_reference: The two settled R65 cells of this exact book shape measured 1.52%/yr and 2.11%/yr at turnover 0.612 and 0.601. This cell is expected to land in the same range; a materially lower figure is a reason to audit the turnover computation, not to celebrate.

parameters.label: XA_CURVE_PARTICIPATION_DEPTH
parameters.signal_definition: depth(m,t) = mean over the 21 sessions ending at t-2 of [ n_contracts_oi_positive(m,s) / n_contracts_summed(m,s) ].
parameters.normalisation_order_binding: STEP 1 compute depth(m,t). STEP 2 subtract the market's own trailing 252-session mean of depth ending at t-2. STEP 3 subtract the r59 economic-group mean of the step-2 value across scorable members at t. STEP 4 rank the step-3 values GLOBALLY across all scorable markets. This order is binding and is frozen here; any other order is a different cell.
parameters.ratio_rationale: Using the RATIO of months-with-OI to months-listed rather than the raw count removes exchange listing-policy changes: if an exchange lists 36 delivery months instead of 12, numerator and denominator move together and the ratio is unchanged. The raw count would be contaminated by listing policy and must not be used.
parameters.window_end_rationale: data_r38.py line 275 states 'Row s = exchange session s. oi_aggregate for s is observable on s+1.' The R65 house one-session revision guard makes the decision instant t-2. The observability instant is DERIVED from the loader's own documented semantics, not asserted.
parameters.group_demeaning_rationale: 68 markets span equity index, rates, FX, volatility and commodities, whose curve shapes and listing conventions differ structurally. Without group demeaning the signal is an asset-class bet, not a capacity signal. A group with fewer than two scorable markets at a decision contributes nothing; single-member groups demean to zero and must not enter the book as spurious neutrals.
parameters.sign_rule: expected_sign -1 is FROZEN. The book goes SHORT the markets with the HIGHEST demeaned participation depth and LONG the LOWEST. Economic reason: low participation depth IS the withdrawal of term risk-bearing capacity, and the market that must attract the marginal holder is the one that pays. A positive net excess is a FAILURE, never a re-read, and never a sign flip.
parameters.zero_open_interest_rule: open_interest == 0 is MISSING, never zero positioning - EXCEPT in the numerator of this feature, where a delivery month with zero open interest is precisely the quantity being counted. THIS IS THE ONE PLACE IN R65 WHERE THE HOUSE ZERO-IS-MISSING RULE IS DELIBERATELY NOT APPLIED, and it is frozen here so it can never be read as a late repair. The rule that DOES apply: a market-session where the whole-curve OI matrix is entirely absent is unscorable, and a market whose matrix is absent on more than 20% of decisions is excluded from the universe.
parameters.halt_open_interest_coverage: If the share of decision-eligible market-sessions carrying a readable whole-curve OI matrix falls below 0.80, halt as DATA_HOLD. Floor 0.80 frozen before measurement.
parameters.halt_cost_budget: COST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED or COST_BUDGET_NOT_EVALUABLE from alpha_agent.r61.cost_budget.evaluate_cost_budget halts before any return is scored. Ceiling 0.03/yr.
parameters.halt_min_markets: Below the FUTURES_DATED_CONTRACT book's declared min_markets the book refuses; the cell settles BOOK_REFUSED.
parameters.halt_provenance: NEW. If any market's rows cannot be attributed to exactly one of the two component datasets with a vintage, halt as DATA_HOLD. A merged panel whose provenance is ambiguous is not a certified panel.
parameters.halt_listing_regime: NEW. If more than 20% of the cross-sectional variance of the step-2 value is attributable to step changes in n_contracts_summed, halt as DATA_HOLD: the signal is measuring exchange listing policy, not market behaviour.
parameters.halt_stage_advance: alpha_agent.r59.engines.stage_advance is the sole authority on D->V->L.
parameters.doubled_cost_adversarial_check: BLOCKING, not advisory, per the R65 cost_realism_ruling.
parameters.cost_per_side_rule: Notional-weighted effective rate from cost_budget.effective_cost_per_side over the R38 per-market vector. Never a uniform rate, never a default.
parameters.clearing_precondition: No director_clear and no forward registration until the OBSERVED per-market futures execution cost table (FUTURES_EXECUTION_COST_REALITY, owned Norgate volume/OI, NO_PURCHASE_REQUIRED) exists, is certified, and this cell is re-scored under it and still passes.
parameters.prior_family_state: BREADTH|EXCHANGE_OPEN_INTEREST_BREADTH|CROSS_ASSET|XS_LONG_SHORT holds ZERO rows. The adjacent POSITIONING|EXCHANGE_OPEN_INTEREST neighbourhood holds four settled nulls (H_b5e5e7c0_483c5c1043eb, H_b5e5e7c0_7f7cdc392f88, H_b5e5e7c0_dc7ca69afa30, H_47e2cf84_1c2df9d04b43) and two pre-measurement rejects (H_b5e5e7c0_f3e92699f95c, H_47e2cf84_49076c9d82f0). The director's position is that this cell is NOT in that family - it counts participating months rather than measuring open-interest size - but the adjacency is recorded here BEFORE measurement so the skeptic attacks the right thing and so no one can later claim it was hidden.

REGISTRATION_TRIGGER_FROZEN_BEFORE_THE_N.rule: REGISTER W2-01 if and only if the MEASURED MDE_80 (ann_net_excess at 80% power) for the actual 68-market panel, at the actual horizon, at the burden denominator alpha_agent.r59.handlers.search_denominator returns for family_key BREADTH|EXCHANGE_OPEN_INTEREST_BREADTH|CROSS_ASSET|XS_LONG_SHORT, is LESS THAN OR EQUAL TO 0.030 (3.0%/yr net). If it is above 0.030, DO NOT REGISTER, and record the cell as BLOCKED_ON_POWER.
REGISTRATION_TRIGGER_FROZEN_BEFORE_THE_N.derivation_of_the_0_030_threshold: Built only from MEASURED quantities, and fixed now so it cannot be fitted to the answer. Measured cost for this exact book shape is 1.52%/yr and 2.11%/yr at turnover ~0.60 - call it 2.0%/yr. The most generous defensible gross effect for a futures term-capacity premium is about 5%/yr. 5.0 minus 2.0 gives 3.0%/yr net as the best case this cell could possibly deliver. If the floor sits above the cell's BEST CASE, the cell cannot clear it under any assumption and registering it would buy a guaranteed UNDERPOWERED filing.
REGISTRATION_TRIGGER_FROZEN_BEFORE_THE_N.no_rounding: 0.0301 is ABOVE the threshold and is a DO_NOT_REGISTER. Borderline is never rounded into a pass.
REGISTRATION_TRIGGER_FROZEN_BEFORE_THE_N.what_may_not_be_done_if_the_trigger_says: Do not widen the panel further to chase the threshold, do not shorten the horizon to chase it, and do not re-run the power measurement with different settings until it passes. Any such change is a NEW cell with a NEW pre-registration and is charged to the burden. The trigger is evaluated ONCE, against the first measurement produced by alpha_agent.r61.power.

W2-01.published_floor_for_the_nearest_calibrat: CROSS_ASSET_FUTURES MDE_80 = IC 0.1096 / 2.98%/yr net at burden 1, 4.19% at burden 10, 5.32% at burden 100, 5.96% at burden 1000, measured on 28 instruments at cadence 21 / horizon 21.
W2-01.denominator_it_will_actually_pay: NOT ASSERTED HERE - it is COUNTED by alpha_agent.r59.handlers.search_denominator at review time. But CROSS_ASSET already carries 2,448 charged rows and total burden is 8,415, so the operative column is 5.3-6.0%/yr net, NOT 2.98%.
W2-01.the_68_market_panel_helps_but_is_unmeasu: 68 markets is 2.4x the 28 on which the floor was measured, which should lower it. I will not assert by how much. W2-01.can_it_plausibly_clear: NOT AT CADENCE 21 ON THE PUBLISHED FLOOR. It needs ~7-8.5%/yr gross to clear 5.3-6.0%/yr net after ~2%/yr measured cost, and its best defensible case is ~5%/yr gross. It clears only if the measured floor for the actual panel and horizon comes in at or below 3.0%/yr net. Hence the trigger, not a registration.

e_INTERPRETATION_RULE.text: If W2-01 is registered and reaches a lockbox and does NOT qualify: if the measured |ann_net_excess| is BELOW the panel MDE_80 at the denominator search_denominator actually used, the outcome MUST be filed with evidence_state UNDERPOWERED and do_not_read_as = EVIDENCE_OF_ABSENCE. It may NOT be reported as evidence that term risk-bearing capacity is unpriced. If the measured |ann_net_excess| is ABOVE that floor and the cell still fails, it IS evidence of absence for this mechanism on this panel, and the family BREADTH|EXCHANGE_OPEN_INTEREST_BREADTH|CROSS_ASSET|XS_LONG_SHORT must be CLOSED with reopen condition NEW_ORTHOGONAL_INFORMATION.
e_INTERPRETATION_RULE.sign_clause: A result of POSITIVE net excess is a FAILURE of a cell whose expected_sign is -1. It is never re-read as a discovery with the sign flipped, and never re-registered as the opposite hypothesis without being charged as a new experiment.
e_INTERPRETATION_RULE.halt_clause: A halt at DATA_HOLD, BOOK_REFUSED or COST_BUDGET_EXCEEDED settles as recorded by alpha_agent.r59.engines.stage_advance and is NOT a null result about the mechanism. It says the cell could not be measured, not that the effect is absent.
